gloss: food poisoning; upset stomach from food

definitions.gloss: food poisoning; upset stomach caused by food
definitions.explanation: illness caused by eating contaminated or spoiled food, typically resulting in stomach pain, nausea, or diarrhea

examples.japanese: {食|しょく}あたりを{起|お}こした。
{生|なま}ものを{食|た}べて{食|しょく}あたりになった。
examples.english: I got food poisoning from eating raw food.

examples.japanese: {夏|なつ}は{食|しょく}あたりに{気|き}をつけなければならない。
examples.english: You have to be careful of food poisoning in summer.

notes:
USAGE:
- {食|しょく}あたりになる (to get food poisoning)
- {食|しょく}あたりを{起|お}こす (to have food poisoning)

SYMPTOMS:
Common symptoms include {吐|は}き{気|け} (nausea), {腹痛|ふくつう} (stomach pain), and {下痢|げり} (diarrhea).

RELATED:
- {食中毒|しょくちゅうどく} (food poisoning - more formal/medical term)
- {傷|いた}む (to go bad - of food)
